name: graphtraj
description: Task graphs and execution traces for local projects.

interface.shortDescription: Use GraphTraj to plan task dependencies, coordinate execution and follow retained results and traces in a user-owned project.
interface.longDescription: GraphTraj manages a task graph and its execution trajectories: accepted work, artifact dependencies, configured Agents, versioned results and retained evidence.
defaultPrompt: GraphTraj connects tasks through the results they need and retains the execution history.
Read only the method needed for the current task.
